sourceStatement: Let f(n) be minimal such that there is a tournament (a complete directed graph) on f(n) vertices such that every set of n vertices is dominated by at least one other vertex. Estimate f(n). Erdos [Er63c] proved 2^(n+1)-1 <= f(n) << n^2 2^n; Szekeres and Szekeres [SzSz65] proved f(3)=19 and n 2^n << f(n). f(1)=3 and f(2)=7 are easy to check.
statusDate: 2026-07-27 (open per erdosproblems.com; status read from the operator-supplied page text, NOT live-fetched by this blade)
nearestPrior: Erdos [Er63c] 2^(n+1)-1 <= f(n) << n^2 2^n; Szekeres & Szekeres [SzSz65] f(3)=19 and n 2^n << f(n); Graham & Spencer [GrSp71] constructive weaker bound. Upper and lower bounds differ by a factor of n.
successCriterion: Close the factor-n gap between n 2^n and n^2 2^n, OR decide a new exact value f(n) for n >= 4, OR move a bound at a finite N by an exact certificate (SAT witness => f(n) <= N; UNSAT refutation => f(n) > N).
